title: Top Trump officials to hold talks with European allies on Russia-Ukraine war
description: The US State Department said Marco Rubio and Steve Witkoff would be in the French capital on Thursday

title: In the Ukrainian city of Sumy, life goes on despite the constant threat of attack
description: SUMY, Ukraine (AP) — The humdrum of daily life in Sumy belies the constant threat of death its people have lived with since Russia invaded Ukraine three years ago.

title: Ukrainian forces 'strike Russian brigade' behind deadly missile attack on Sumy
description: A Russian assault on the city killed 35 people on Sunday. Ukraine's foreign ministry said a baby girl was among the 119 injured, adding "even newborns are targets for Russia's crimes".

title: Russia’s 'mutinous' General Popov to head notorious unit of ex-convicts after criticising defence ministry
description: Once hailed as a decorated commander of Russia’s 58th Combined Arms Army in Ukraine, Popov now finds himself reportedly tasked with leading a Russian military battalion made up of former convicts, notorious for its heavy casualties and suicide-style assaults

title: Ukraine war latest: Putin's 'request for peace' revealed to Trump envoy at meeting
description: Donald Trump's envoy Steve Witkoff says US-Russia talks to end the war could be on the "verge of something that would be very, very important for the world at large". Follow the latest on the Ukraine war.

title: Ukraine war latest: Trump envoy told 'Putin's request' for peace at St Petersburg meeting
description: Donald Trump's envoy Steve Witkoff says US-Russia talks to end the war could be on the "verge of something that would be very, very important for the world at large". Follow the latest on the Ukraine war.

title: Ukraine war latest: Russia dismisses European leadership as 'frenzy'
description: Vladimir Putin's foreign minister Sergei Lavrov has said peace talks with the US are "not easy" and dismissed European leadership as a "frenzy". Meanwhile, an elderly Russian woman has been killed in a "massive" Ukrainian drone strike. Follow the latest on the war.

title: Russia says it is not easy to agree Ukraine peace deal with US
description: Key components of settlement being discussed, says Sergei Lavrov

title: Is Russia mocking US peace efforts in Ukraine?
description: Despite US led ceasefire talks, Russian forces have killed scores of Ukrainian civilians in missile attacks on two Ukrainian cities over the past two weekends. RTÉ's Eastern Europe Reporter Liam Nolan looks at how serious Russia is about engaging in US peace efforts to end the war?

title: Ukrainian drone attack on Russia's Kursk kills woman
description: The Russian city of Kursk near the Ukraine border has been hit with an overnight drone attack that killed an elderly woman and injured nine others.
